subject: URGENT: Production 429 spike impacting real-time recommendations
messages:
From: Sophie Hayes <sophie@glacierhealth.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Glacier] Sudden 429/timeout surge on /v1/generate - urgent

Aditya,

We started seeing a major increase in 429s and upstream timeouts on the real-time recommendations route (~09:05 PDT). Our clients are experiencing intermittent failures and the retry logic in our app has amplified latency — some sessions are timing out. Attached are request traces and a short log extract.

Key points:
- 429 rate went from ~0.2% to >18% in ~3 minutes
- Most errors report "quota exceeded" and the gateway returns 429 with X-Rate-Limit: 60/60
- Retry storm visible from our side: repeated 3x retries by our SDK within <5s, compounding the issue

We need immediate help. Can you confirm if this is an org-level quota change, project-level misconfiguration, or something else on your side? Please advise mitigation steps; we can put in a maintenance page or pause non-critical traffic.

--
Sophie Hayes
Head of Platform Engineering, Glacier Health
Attachments: glacier-429-logs-0725.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hayes <sophie@glacierhealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Glacier] Sudden 429/timeout surge on /v1/generate - urgent

Sophie — thanks for the quick alert and the logs. I'm escalating to our ops and infra leads now (cc'd). Initial ask: could you hold non-essential background traffic for 15 minutes while we investigate? We'll triage immediately and propose a short mitigation.

I see the X-Rate-Limit headers you mentioned; we'll verify whether a config change propagated at org or project scope and if any tiering rules were applied by mistake.

I'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until we have a fix.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: [Glacier] Sudden 429/timeout surge on /v1/generate - urgent

Aditya / Lauren / Marissa — initial findings from quick ops check: 
- The org-level quota for Glacier's account had an emergency override applied yesterday during a capacity test; however the routing layer mistakenly attached the override to a single project namespace rather than the org. That caused per-project buckets to be consumed rapidly.
- Their SDK's retry configuration (3 immediate retries) combined with our strict per-project token bucket created a feedback loop — many clients hit the project bucket, got 429, retried immediately, and retried again.
- We reproduced a similar spike in our staging by simulating parallel connections with short retry windows.

Immediate mitigations applied (09:35 PDT):
1) Relaxed per-project rate limit for Glacier's primary project from 60rpm to 600rpm for 60 minutes (temporary).
2) Enabled a short client-side advisory header to ask clients to back off (Retry-After: 5) for non-critical routes.
3) Rolled a runbook: runbook-temp-rate-adjustment.md attached.

Next steps:
- Recommend updating their SDK retry policy to exponential backoff — we'll share suggested settings.
- We'll roll a permanent fix to ensure org-level overrides attach properly to org buckets and not to project buckets.

I'll coordinate a hotfix timeline after we confirm load patterns later today.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Serving Runtime

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Executive Leadership <leadership@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: Glacier Health production impact & proposed customer remediation

Team — looping in leadership because this hit a production customer and may require commercial remediation. Summary: Glacier Health experienced a 429 spike caused by an accidental scope misassignment of a quota override + customer retry behavior. Rishi applied temporary rate relaxation.

Recommended customer remediation (provisional):
- Provide Glacier a service credit for the hour of impacted traffic (propose 20% credit against July usage) to acknowledge pain and potential downstream SLA breach.
- Offer a 2-week priority support window and a joint review with their platform team to harden SDK and retry behavior.
- Postmortem and timeline for permanent quota-fix: aim for deploy by 2026-07-30 EOD.

Please advise if leadership approves the proposed credit and customer-facing messaging.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Hayes <sophie@glacierhealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Glacier] Sudden 429/timeout surge on /v1/generate - urgent

Sophie — quick update and apology for the disruption.

What we did right away:
- Increased the project's per-minute allowance as a temporary buffer (should eliminate most 429s).
- Pushed advisory headers to discourage aggressive client retries for non-critical calls.
- Our engineers are scheduling a short conference with your platform team if you're available to tune your SDK backoff settings (15m call recommended).

We also plan to:
- Deliver a postmortem by 2026-07-30 with root cause and timeline for the org-quota scope fix.
- Offer a 20% credit for the impacted hourly window and two weeks of priority support while we validate the fix (Lauren has proposed this and is looping in leadership).

Can you confirm whether you want us to proactively throttle certain background jobs or if you'll pause them on your side? Also – do you have a preferred time for the call this afternoon?

Apologies again for the outage; we'll take ownership and drive to resolution.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Hayes <sophie@glacierhealth.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@glacierhealth.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Glacier] Sudden 429/timeout surge on /v1/generate - urgent

Thanks Aditya — the temporary changes stopped the tail of the spike and our surface-level errors are back to normal. Appreciate the rapid response.

We accept the proposed credit and would like the two-week priority support. Please schedule the SDK tuning review tomorrow morning (Pacific). We also want the full postmortem when available; include the exact change that caused the override to misapply and your deploy checklist for preventing recurrence.

We are preparing a short internal incident note and will share any additional traces if you need them.

Best,
Sophie
Head of Platform Engineering, Glacier Health
